propositions: gate_status() reports a terminal verdict (passed/BLOCK) before the corresponding REVIEW_RESULT sidecar is readable, allowing callers to silently consume stale findings from a prior run
sidecar.emit() returned only a bool and no receipt; the async gate-run index discarded sidecar identity/outcome, making it impossible to distinguish current findings from stale latest findings
for BLOCK verdicts, attestation is unsigned by design, so durable currency cannot prove findings readiness or differentiate current from prior-run sidecars
gate_status() must add a findings block with readable, reason, reviewed_at, and latest_reviewed_at to prove exact-prefix sidecar identity before pollers read findings
sidecar_reviewed_at must be carried as an exact timestamp receipt from append_event() through emit/reuse and the terminal run index to enable per-job readability proof
